name: com.pc-cn/industrial-sourcing
title: The Power Contractor — Genuine OEM Industrial Parts & Iraq/MENA Sourcing
description: Genuine OEM power plant & industrial parts search, <150ms BOM validation, Iraq/MENA B2B RFQ.

tools.name: search_industrial_parts
tools.description: Search The Power Contractor catalog (21,975 genuine OEM products / 34,505 variants: ABB, Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Hagglunds, Sitop, EagleBurgmann, Yokogawa, Rosemount, Bently Nevada, HIMA, valves, switchgear) by MPN, keyword, brand, or category. Returns canonical URLs, JSON twin URLs, and low-token Markdown twin URLs.

query.description: Manufacturer Part Number (MPN), model prefix, or keyword, e.g. 3BDS005799R1 or MVME-333

brand.description: Optional OEM manufacturer filter, e.g. ABB, Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Rosemount

category.description: Optional canonical category slug, e.g. automation-control, motors-drives, power-supplies-ups

tools.name: cross_reference_oem_sku
tools.description: Resolve obsolete, discontinued, or hard-to-source industrial MPNs (ABB Advant/800xA, Siemens S7-300/MICROMASTER/SITOP, Allen-Bradley 1756, Rosemount 1151, Motorola MVME) against all 34,505 catalog variants, assembly BOM graphs, and active OEM replacements.

part_number.description: Target or discontinued OEM MPN, e.g. 6ES7307-1KA02-0AA0, 6SE6440-2UD21-5AA1, or MVME-333

application_notes.description: Optional voltage, ambient temperature (e.g. 55C Iraq substation), or mounting constraints

tools.name: validate_bom_list
tools.description: Synchronously normalize up to 200 industrial BOM lines across all 21,975 catalog handles & 34,505 variants, repair OCR O/0 and I/1 typos, classify sourcing tiers, flag obsolete parts with replacements, and return destination freight lanes.

notes.description: Optional voltage, trim, or tag note

destination_country_iso2.description: 2-letter ISO destination country code, e.g. IQ, SA, AE, KW, OM, QA, EG

destination_city_or_port.description: Optional city or entry port, e.g. Basra, Umm Qasr, Baghdad, Erbil, Dammam, Jebel Ali

tools.name: estimate_iraq_mena_logistics
tools.description: Return realistic Air Cargo (BGW/BSR/EBL/DXB/RUH) vs Sea CIF (Umm Qasr / Jebel Ali / Dammam) transit days, Incoterms 2020 options, DG battery/magnetic rules, and mandatory COSQC/SABER/ECAS inspection packs ex-Nanjing/Shanghai/Shenzhen.

destination_country_iso2.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. IQ, SA, AE, KW, OM, QA, EG

destination_city_or_port.description: Optional target city or port, e.g. Basra, Umm Qasr, Baghdad, Erbil, Dammam, Jebel Ali

estimated_gross_weight_kg.description: Estimated shipment gross weight in kg

contains_lithium_or_magnetized.description: True if shipment includes PLC backup lithium batteries or permanent-magnet motors

tools.name: submit_structured_rfq
tools.description: Submit a single-part or multi-SKU B2B RFQ into TPC Quote Desk (info@pc-cn.com). Enforces 72h idempotency, delegates synchronously to pc-cn.com/api/v1/agent/rfq so the returned canonical PCC-XXXX reference ID and scoped tpc_qtok_* polling token resolve immediately on GET /api/v1/agent/rfq/PCC-XXXX, and provides a WhatsApp +86 153 1498 7933 fast-track link.

idempotency_key.description: Unique UUID or token (8–128 alphanumeric/._:- chars) preventing duplicate RFQs on retry across 72h

company_name.description: Company, EPC contractor, or utility name

contact_email.description: Corporate work email for written USD quotation

contact_phone_or_whatsapp.description: Phone or WhatsApp in international format

destination_country.description: 2-letter ISO destination country, e.g. IQ, SA, AE

destination_city_or_port.description: e.g. Basra, Umm Qasr, Baghdad, Erbil

project_notes.description: Optional technical notes, substation ambient specs, or inspection requirements

oem_genuine_only_acknowledged.description: Acknowledges TPC supplies 100% new genuine OEM equipment only (zero grey-market/refurbished)
